_meta.what: Row-by-row review of the 128 n8n daily-signal rows (May–Sep 2026) and the repo's own briefs, done 5 Sep 2026 after the MD saw the first app export and said several entries 'look irrelevant and bad' (TDK, Disney+, Nissan …). Applied at export time (intel/site_export.py) — the database keeps every row; the app shows screened rows under 'Screened out' with the reason, collapses duplicates into the kept row, and tags rows that still need a human check.
_meta.how: Each row was checked against: the live sponsor table (existing F1/FE partner → screened), the blocklist and the approached list, the ICP (B2B, deal-capable, capacity ≥ $1B valuation or $100M ARR or public), whether the row is a rights-holder/team/broadcaster rather than a prospect, duplicate entries of the same trigger, and obvious data faults (undisclosed decision-maker, wrong source, inconsistent facts).
_meta.statuses: screened_out (with reason code) · duplicate_of (kept key) · keep_flagged (needs a human check before it is shown as a clean signal) · keep (default for anything not listed)

reason_codes.existing_partner: already an F1 / FE / team partner (sponsor table or the row itself says so)
reason_codes.rights_holder: a team, the championship, a broadcaster or a supplier — not a prospect
reason_codes.approached: already approached by the 1440 team — never re-pitch cold
reason_codes.off_profile: consumer / B2C, or a category with no B2B sponsorship logic
reason_codes.no_trigger: no capital or leadership event — an association, not a signal
reason_codes.below_capacity: fails the capacity gate (valuation < $1B and no $100M ARR / listing)
reason_codes.too_early: seed / first institutional money; brand budget not there yet
reason_codes.category_conflict: conflicts with a supplier category the series already locks (tyres, fuel)
